draft.text: You came in because you have had pain on the inside of your right elbow for four days.
The pain is worse when you bend your wrist or use your arm for pottery.
The X-ray of your elbow showed no problems with the bones.
You do not have swelling, redness, stiffness, or numbness in your elbow or hand.
The cause of your pain is not clear.
It is not related to a bone problem, and you have no history of injury or repetitive strain.
You should take breaks when doing activities that make your pain worse.
You will need to come back in one week for a follow-up to see if more treatment is needed.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you have had pain on the inside of your right elbow for 4 days.
The pain gets worse when you bend your wrist or use your arm for pottery.
You said the pain is not helped by ice or ibuprofen.
You have had trouble sleeping and cannot work on your pottery because of the pain.
There is no swelling, redness, or stiffness in your elbow.
You have not had any numbness or tingling in your hand or fingers.
You have not felt any pain in your hand or fingers, only along the inside of your arm.
There was no clicking, locking, or popping in your elbow.
You have not had any weakness in your grip or trouble lifting things with your right hand.
An X-ray of your right elbow was done and showed no fractures or bone problems.
You should keep using ice and ibuprofen as needed for pain.
You were told to take breaks during activities that make the pain worse and avoid those activities if possible.
You need to come back in 1 week for a follow-up to check on your pain and see if more treatment is needed.
